subLocations.name: The Willing Smile
subLocations.lore: A seedy low-[[coin]] rundown brothel, a once-fashionable destination on a once-fashionable street.

subLocations.lore: A boisterous club with a sign depicting a woman with a bent [[bow]] surrounded by hungry [[wolves]].
